name: Orbit Spatial Studio
domain: Interactive spatial exploration and creative prototyping
audience: Designers and engineers exploring relationships before committing structure
jobs: Move between overview and precise inspection without losing place

traits.density: A quiet stage with dense detail at the active locus
traits.hierarchy: Spatial focus plus a stable DOM inspector and breadcrumb
traits.typography: Technical sans labels with large coordinate-like display type
traits.motion: Continuous motion is decorative and optional; navigation motion preserves orientation

semantics: Spatial relationships always have an equivalent named DOM representation and stable selection state.
behavior: Overview, focus, and precise inspection preserve location and selection across transitions.
accessibility: Canvas motion is optional while keyboard, focus, reduced motion, and DOM inspection remain complete.
contentLocale: Coordinates, labels, and long Korean descriptions remain distinct and readable at every scale.
dataTruth: The canvas scene and the inspector expose the same selected entity, relation, and evidence state.
permissionsPrivacy: Imported spatial assets disclose origin and stay local unless export is explicitly authorized.
recovery: A failed transform can return to the last stable view, selection, and camera state.

signatureMoment: A selected relation sends one restrained pulse across the stage while the equivalent DOM inspector announces the change.
